body:
I have been addicted to opiates for quite some time now.  I have numerous, painful medical conditions which require pain management of sorts.  I was recently diagnosed with myofacial neuropathy as well, and was prescribed neurontin for the pain.  I
I also have major depressive disorder, PTSD, and generalized anxiety.  But not on neurontin!!!  I recently ran out of my Percocet, probably because I wasnt taking them as prescribed, and was looking for a way to control the withdrawal.  Neurontin DEFINITELY takes care of that!!  (I realize this may be a bit jumbled and that there are a lot of !, but I am currently on a Neurontin ride.)  So, anyway, I figured if N could control withdrawal, it must be pretty powerful stuff and could probably get me messed up.
I took a mega dose of N for the first time a couple of weeks ago, but Id like to talk about how Im feeling right now.  Let me put it this way.  I have a roommate who has a 4-year-old, they are not here during the day as he works and the kiddo goes to daycare, and I am incredibly fascinated by her toys right now.  Even though I feel like Im in a giant bubble made of  warm gelatin and that my thought processes are way delayed, I also feel incredibly clear.  On a side note, I just responded to a text message I got and my phone appeared to be SUPER tiny, which caused me to giggle uncontrollably.  Back to the toys!!  I hate Barbie dolls and anything girly, but I am playing with them right now.  They seem like they are alive and need my attention.  I am also playing with something called a LaLa Loopsy doll.  What?!?!?!?!?!?
The moral of my story.Neurontin has got to be one of the best highs I have ever been on.  There is no withdrawal from it, no cotton-mouth or any other annoying side-effects, and its easy to get, much easier than opiates these days.  The high is also super mellow, and lasts for quite a long time.  I popped about 6000mg yesterday throughout the day, and woke up this morning feeling pleasantly buzzed.  I would not drive while on N though, depth perception and peripheral vision are most definitely altered.  Also, who DOESNT want to be a kid again????????????  N is definitely my ticket to a trip back to childhood.
